scenarios.name: Keep a panel hidden when redocking the floating ribbon

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the floating 3D Model ribbon shows the Modify group
the user hides Modify through Show Panels
the floating ribbon no longer shows the Modify group
the user docks the ribbon at the top
the top ribbon does not show the Modify panel
the user opens Show Panels on the top ribbon
the Modify panel is visible again
